Section heading.
cairn combines an editor-oriented git-backed CMS with a SvelteKit toolkit developers build on.
The content is stored as markdown files inside the repository the organization itself owns.
Each publish lands in git as a commit credited to the person who wrote it.
Git alone supplies the record of changes, the credit, and the ability to undo.
The writer never sees the git machinery.
A developer's custom screen mounts within the admin, reusing its components and login; the admin doubles as a toolkit.
Later-built screens feel like part of one product instead of an app bolted alongside.
